create_kernel_density_estimator: create a KernelDensity estimator with a specified kernel type and bandwidth for 1D density estimation
fit_kernel_density_model: fit a KernelDensity model to 1D sample data using the fit method on a numpy array
score_samples_with_kde: score log-density samples from a fitted KernelDensity model at specified query points
compare_kde_kernels: compare gaussian, tophat, epanechnikov, exponential, linear, and cosine kernel density estimates on 1D data
visualize_1d_density_distribution: visualize 1D kernel density estimates overlaid on histogram bins and input distribution
